limitations: Mosaic Desk, all outputs, context units, sources, and results are fictional and synthetic.
The proposal validator is pedagogical and does not replace a complete schema, factuality, permission, or authorization system.
Context teaching units are not real tokens and no live position, cache, latency, cost, or quality result is claimed.
The retrieval fixture selects no embedding model, index, store, chunker, or reranker and proves no retrieval quality.
Figure records are semantic anchors only; root owns ImageGen production.
